summary: Craze & Crash's first scout run (hooks and the first 30 seconds). I outlined the five top long topics and added 4 sourced facts to them, and routed 3 intro items. Studio has never run for this channel, so I raised that with the owner.
why: The feed had 11 usable long topics but none had an outline, which is what Studio leans on hardest. YouTube measures a long video's intro at 30 s, while our arc runs to 65 s. The long backlog is 0 and the channel's long slots are Tuesday and Friday.

findings.title: YouTube's Intro = viewers still watching after 30 s, and it checks the title and thumbnail
findings.detail: A high Intro means the first 30 s matched the title and thumbnail's promise.
